card.name: Words before a missing object
card.fires_on: Short linking or modifier words (about, including, your, my, serious) that sit right before a noun phrase the model must supply next. Mostly in poetry and literary text, and sometimes in warning lists in drug labels.

modes.label: Poetry and literary text
modes.description: A word such as about, your, my or the, placed just before the object of a poetic line.
